label: prop:hook-weight-derivation
title: Hook weight $\beta_4 = -\tfrac{1}{2} w_{[2,2]}(4)$ from baryon Wedderburn-Artin decomposition
html:
Proposition (conditional on conj:shell-transition-knot). The coefficient of the hook invariant \Phi_4 in the four-channel mass formula is

  \beta_4 = -\tfrac{1}{2}\, w_{[2,2]}(4)
          = -\frac{\dim_q([2,2])^2}{2\,[4]_q!}
          \approx -0.083

where w_{[2,2]}(4) = \dim_q([2,2])^2 / [4]_q! is the Wedderburn-Artin weight of the hook partition [2,2] in H_4(R, q), the baryon's internal Hecke algebra (3 quarks + gluon = 4 strands).
